title: Venus has a surprisingly long day!
description: Venus takes about 243 Earth days to complete one rotation. That is longer than its year, which lasts about 225 Earth days.
reaction: Imagine your day being longer than your whole year. No thanks. 💀

title: Octopuses have three hearts!
description: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood. Two hearts help move blood through the gills, while the third circulates it around the body.
reaction: Three hearts?! Octopus is clearly doing the most. 😭

title: Sharks are older than trees!
description: Sharks appeared in the fossil record hundreds of millions of years ago, before the earliest trees.
reaction: Sharks were here before trees. They are basically ancient celebrities. 💀

title: The Earth is not a perfect sphere!
description: Earth is slightly wider around its middle than from the North Pole to the South Pole.
reaction: Earth is not even a perfect ball. The planet has lore. 😭

title: A day on Venus is longer than its year!
description: Venus rotates very slowly. It takes longer to spin once than it takes to travel around the Sun.
reaction: Imagine your day being longer than your whole year. No thanks. 💀

title: Water has a special triple point!
description: At a particular temperature and pressure, water can exist as solid ice, liquid water and water vapour together.
reaction: Water can pull off a three-state combo. Physics is showing off. 🤯

title: Wombats produce cube-shaped droppings!
description: Wombats are famous for producing cube-shaped droppings. The shape forms inside their intestines.
reaction: Nature really said: let’s make cubes. Who approved this? 😭

title: The Sun is about 109 times wider than Earth!
description: The Sun is so enormous that its diameter is about 109 times the diameter of Earth.
reaction: Earth is giving tiny side character energy next to the Sun. 😭

title: 30 Earths could fit between Earth and the Moon!
description: The average distance between Earth and the Moon is large enough to fit about 30 Earth-sized planets in between.
reaction: The Moon is not as close as it looks. Space has no business being this huge. 💀
